what: Pressing the header menu button drops a screen-wide white panel from the top edge with scaleY .4s ease, the screen behind darkens to .55 (.4s), and the card row inside rises 2rem from below with a .1s delay over .4s. Pressing again, or the curtain, a card or Esc, retracts it quickly: panel .2s, inner .25s, curtain .2s. Pressing another menu closes the previous panel

options.--fx-open / --fx-close: Panel open and close duration, default .4s · .2s
options.--fx-rise: Distance the card row floats up, default 2rem
options.--fx-origin: Side the panel unfolds from, default top (bottom if there is a tab bar below on phones)
options.[data-fx-part=trigger] · [data-fx-part=p: Press button · card row and back scrim inside the panel (position and spacing set by the consumer)

use: • Card row
note: The panel covers the width of the nearest positioned ancestor (usually the fixed header row) with position: absolute — do not give position to the li wrapping the button

from.where: shared.js and shared.css .kk-sub (ABOUT·SERVICES card expand — on phone it rises above the bottom tab bar, original .hasSub.isActive)
